description: The trial balance (ACC-07, W2-01 plan, owner answer 4). Each account's opening is its debits − credits before the period, its movement the period's debits and credits, its closing the opening plus the movement; a balance sits on its debit or credit side. A group's row is the sum of each column of the rows beneath it, so debits equal credits at every level. Rows run down the chart's tree, each group's children by code. Hidden unless asked for: an account with no opening and no movement, and a group with nothing beneath it. `groups` shows the groups only (and any postable account without a parent). A sum for an account not in the chart is refused.

cases.name: a month on a chart with a group three levels deep: opening, sales, a return, salaries, a reversed voucher, a supplier payment
groups only: the same month, one row per group
with the empty accounts shown: an empty group and its account, retained earnings and General at zero
a postable account at the top of the chart stays in groups only; books that do not balance say so
